name: prose-lint
description: Runs the wording linters on a Japanese or English document and rules on every hit: textlint with Japanese and English configs (the kana rules of 内閣訓令 through prh and the hiragana rules, い抜き・さ入れ・フィラー, the AI-writing preset), a register of rejected wordings that you grow row by row (definition by negation, the spoken register, the stock phrases of generated Japanese), natural-japanese's lint with its naturalness score and baseline rerun, a sudachipy morphology lint (four checks from 公用文作成の考え方 and five house rules), and vale with proselint, the ai-tells package and two house rules for the signs of LLM-written English.
